notes: Per-character voice identity. local_voice is the macOS `say` voice; espeak_voice is the eSpeak NG voice/variant used on Linux and CI. pitch_scale and rate_scale shape each character on top of the per-beat delivery profiles. runway_voice is sent to Runway when NOVA_VOICE_BACKEND=runway; Brodie is the current testing voice, so replace it per character once final voices are chosen. runway_speech_voice is the Runway speech preset chosen per character for generate_speech (eleven_v3); it must be mapped to the API preset id before the API backend uses it.
